info.description: Generated OpenAPI schema for Soma's direct REST surface. Auth modes: loopback/trusted-gateway deployments may have no local auth; mounted bearer mode uses SOMA_MCP_TOKEN; OAuth mode uses bearer JWTs. REST actions require their action-specific scopes when auth is mounted.
